coverage.meaning: Declared spans only; overlaps retained; uncovered bytes and semantic completeness are not inferred.

display_definitions.I: Ordered declared interpretation IDs and statuses; none means no interpretation was supplied.
display_definitions.M: Typed meaning units with indexed operator trees, fixed dictionary identities and declared context dependencies; interpretation and adequacy remain unproved.
display_definitions.R: Ordered declared relations, written first kind second; no causality, execution or authority is implied.
display_definitions.U: Ordered uncertainty IDs; none means no uncertainty record was supplied, not absence of uncertainty.
display_definitions.anchor: Half-open offsets [begin,end) in exact original bytes with SHA-256 of the selected bytes; a reference only, not entailment.
display_definitions.Σ: Documentary source group only; not an arithmetic sum, universal quantifier or completeness claim.

relation_definitions.contradicts: Declared conflict between the first record and the second; no inconsistency is proved.
relation_definitions.derived_from: The first record is declared derived from the second; no derivation is checked.
relation_definitions.qualifies: The first record declares a qualification on the second; no scope or adequacy is verified.
relation_definitions.supersedes: The first record is declared to replace the second in this reading; no authority is granted.
relation_definitions.supports: Declared support from the first record to the second; no entailment or truth is verified.

sources.label: Exact Alpha source
sources.provenance: Manual frozen fixture, no semantic qualification.
